The issue was that `Style.clear_meta_and_links` was copying the `_hash` attribute from the original style to the new style, even though the meta and link information (which are part of the hash calculation) were being removed. This resulted in the new style having the same hash as the original style, which is incorrect. I fixed this by setting `style._hash = None` in `clear_meta_and_links`, ensuring that the hash is re-calculated correctly when needed. I verified the fix with a reproduction script.
